# Lisbon 4-Day City Break Plan

A low-hill, museum-friendly Lisbon itinerary for 2 adults, built around walkable neighborhoods, one food market stop, and weather-proof backup ideas. Costs are estimated for **2 adults** and stay within your **€1,200 total budget excluding flights**.

# Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Cost Plan

## Day 1 — Baixa, Chiado, and the riverfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and do an easy flat walk through **Baixa** and **Praça do Comércio**.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **MUDE / design or a central museum** if open, then continue through **Chiado** with café stops.
- **Evening:** Sunset stroll along the **riverfront** and dinner in a central neighborhood.
- **Transit:** Use the **Metro** to Baixa-Chiado or Terreiro do Paço; keep walking routes short and flat.
- **Estimated cost:** Museum tickets **€20–€30**, transit **€10–€15**, meals **€70–€110**, total **€100–€155**.

## Day 2 — Alfama edge + National Tile Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Start at the **National Tile Museum**; it is a strong indoor option and avoids the steepest hill-heavy wandering.
- **Afternoon:** Explore the **lower Alfama edge** and viewpoints reachable by short walks or tram/taxi combinations.
- **Evening:** Casual dinner near **Graça / Martim Moniz / central Lisbon** rather than deep uphill.
- **Transit:** Use **tram or taxi/Uber** for the hillier segments; walk only the flatter connectors.
- **Estimated cost:** Tickets **€20–€35**, transit **€15–€25**, meals **€70–€110**, total **€105–€170**.

## Day 3 — Food market + waterfront museums
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Time Out Market** for breakfast or lunch and sample a few local bites.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Morning:** Visit **Time Out Market** for breakfast or lunch and sample a few local bites, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Afternoon:** Choose one waterfront museum or exhibition near **Cais do Sodré / Belém-side transport corridor** depending on energy.
- **Evening:** Relaxed dinner and an early night.
- **Transit:** Metro or train for the market area; taxi/Uber if you want to minimize walking between stops.
